dailyDashboard.title: Choose a reason to go outside
dailyDashboard.lead: Record, revisit, or look nearby. The first screen stays focused on enjoying nature today.
dailyDashboard.seasonalEmpty: Seasonal clues are still being collected

recordToday.title: Save today's find
recordToday.body: Save what you found with a photo and a short note.

revisitPlace.title: Go back to a place you walked
revisitPlace.body: The same place changes when the season moves.

nearbyPulse.title: See where nearby records are moving
nearbyPulse.body: Use active areas as a reason for the next walk.

needsId.title: Open a record that needs a name
needsId.body: Turn an uncertain record into the next discovery.

landing.toolSectionTitle: Look on site. Choose from the map.
landing.toolSectionLead: Check what caught your eye, or choose where to walk next. Both paths lead back to a record you can revisit.

lens.title: Look closer at what caught your eye
lens.body: Point the camera and AI returns candidates and clues. It helps you keep the moment without pretending to be the final answer.

scan.title: Choose today's walk from the map
scan.body: Use nearby finds, seasonal changes, and gaps to choose the next place worth walking.

landing.mapSectionTitle: Find places that make you want to walk again
landing.mapSectionLead: Nearby paths and travel stops both hold reasons for the next walk. See what has been found and decide one next step.
landing.mapEmpty: No observations on the map yet

fieldLoop.title: Find. Learn. Save. Help someone else.
fieldLoop.lead: Find something, check a few clues, and save it with the place. The more people keep these small records, the easier nearby nature becomes to understand.

steps.title: 1. Find
steps.body: Notice something on a walk or while traveling.

steps.title: 2. Learn
steps.body: Use AI clues and your own eyes to look a little closer.

steps.title: 3. Save
steps.body: Keep the photo, place, time, and a short note together.

steps.title: 4. Help
steps.body: Small records can become clues for local nature, research, and conservation.

principles: Keep records even before you know the name.
Turn each record into the next walk.

community.title: Community | ZUKAN
community.heading: Join walks and themed surveys
community.lead: Start with a solo walk, then sometimes look at the same place with others. Community events, themed surveys, and small local programs live here.

learnIndex.title: Reading index | ZUKAN
learnIndex.heading: Reading index
learnIndex.lead: One topic per page: how to start observing, check names, and keep records useful later.

map.title: Life map | ZUKAN
map.footerNote: Zoom in to see where records, species, parks, and water-side clues are gathering.

lens.title: Observe in the moment | ZUKAN
lens.footerNote: AI offers possible names and identification tips. People make the decision.

hero.heading: Take a closer look at something that caught your eye
hero.lead: Whether you are out for a walk or traveling, point your camera at a creature you are curious about. AI can offer possible names and identification tips. You do not have to decide here. Start by saving what you found.

steps.title: 1. Save what you saw
steps.body: It is okay not to know what it is. First, keep the photo, place, time, and what you noticed.

steps.title: 2. Check what to look for next
steps.body: Use AI tips to narrow down the features to check next instead of relying only on the suggested name.

steps.title: 3. Add your observations to a record
steps.body: This page does not save records. Add the photo, place, time, and notes together on the record page.

guidanceCards.title: When you want to keep a moment from a walk or a trip
guidanceCards.body: Use this when you would rather save what you saw and compare it later than decide on an answer right away.

guidanceCards.title: AI offers clues; you make the decision.
guidanceCards.body: AI suggests possibilities and tips for telling them apart. It does not decide the name for you.

guidanceCards.title: Save the photo and place in a record
guidanceCards.body: This page does not save records. Add the place, time, and photo together on the record page.

followupCards.title: Keep what you found in your records
followupCards.body: On the record page, add photos, places, and notes together. Your saved records become a library you can revisit later.
followupCards.meta: One place to save, another to browse later.

followupCards.title: Pick a place on the map first
followupCards.body: If you want to choose where to walk before looking up a name, open the map first.
followupCards.meta: This page helps you look more closely at something you found; the map helps you choose where to go next.

followupCards.eyebrow: For a continuous guide while walking
followupCards.title: Use the live guide for continuous recording
followupCards.body: This page helps you look at one finding at a time. For continuous video or audio while walking, use the live guide.
followupCards.meta: One finding at a time here; continuous recording in the live guide.
